title: A company's own decision models: exported, fine-tuned on DCLab's base, gated and served in its workspace
request: Let every company and machine-learning engineer fine-tune their own decision models from DCLab's.
spec: dclab_core/own_models.py (stacking on the base classifier), dclab_rnd/own_models.py (export, fit, gate, status, current), routing and shadow reading a workspace's own models.
plan: Keep every row in the workspace folder.
Never change the base model: read its answer as features.
Judge on the workspace's own sealed projects, once per decision; route only in that workspace.

decisions.decision: Fine-tuning is stacking on the base model's probabilities.
decisions.why: A company has few rows; the base model's reading carries what it knows, and it stays untouched.

decisions.decision: To act, an own model needs its shadow measurement, not DCLab's journeys.
decisions.why: The journeys are DCLab's replicas, not the company's decisions.

change: own_models (core and studio), routing.passed(home), switch(home), answer finding own@ models, shadow answering own models in shadow.

findings.defect: The own model's gate compared it with the person's corrections instead of the rule.
findings.scenario: After a person's correction value_used is the person's value, so the rule looked nearly perfect.
findings.cause: value_used was taken as the rule's answer.
findings.fix: The rule's own answer is read from the record's answers.

findings.defect: A workspace's sealed decisions could be judged again after new projects arrived.
findings.scenario: The read mark was one fingerprint of the whole set.
findings.cause: Adding a sealed project changed the fingerprint.
findings.fix: The ids read are kept; a later gate judges only decisions never read.

findings.defect: An own model could not be served.
findings.cause: Routing and shadow loaded only DCLab's folders.
findings.fix: routing.switch and answer, and shadow, read the workspace's own models.

outcome: A workspace fine-tunes, gates and serves its own decision model end to end in its folder, and DCLab's base model is untouched.
lessons: After a person's correction, the record's used value is theirs: compare with the rule's own answer.
risks: The LoRA path for a company's own language model is 27.10.
